text:
ravi: Heads up — seeing a sustained GPU provisioning backlog in eu-west2. Lots of nodes hitting local NVMe iops limits and a handful threw overlayfs checksum warnings. Pods stuck Pending because scratch I/O is saturated.

sophia: ugh. any dmesg / iostat snippets? is this after the janitor change last night? :grimacing:

ravi: attaching quick excerpts. noticed spike right when cleaner ran across many nodes.
```
# iostat -xm 1 3
Device:         r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s avgrq-sz  avgqu-sz  await r_await w_await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1       120.3   980.7  8192.0  65536.0   72.0     4.12    28.5   2.1    30.4    0.45   98.7
```

```
[ 1432.123456] overlayfs: checksum mismatch on lower dentry, inode=1234567
[ 1432.123860] EXT4-fs (nvme0n1p1): warning: mounting fs with errors, running e2fsck recommended
```

michael: that avg queue + %util basically explains the Pending GPUs. Cleaner likely doing deep-scan and causing read amplification. Which janitor window did we schedule?

ravi: janitor window is the default nightly 02:00 UTC sweep, but last night we rolled a more aggressive deep-scrub sampler (reduced batch size but increased concurrency). I think concurrency = 8 across nodes.

sophia: ok — immediate mitigation options? throttle the cleaner, reduce concurrency, or pause it for eu-west2. Also we can temporarily route provisioning to other regions (fallback pool) but that costs us latency.

james: for short-term: pause janitor in eu-west2 and scale up a small pool of nodes with larger ephemeral bandwidth for GPU attaches. then we can gradually resume with concurrency=1. I can push the pause if infra owners + oncall agree.

infra-bot: [alert] eu-west2: scratchpool iops saturation detected (nodes: 18/120 above 85% iops util). Auto-throttle suggested: reduce janitor concurrency by 75%.

michael: agree with pause. also we should add a temporary safety valve to the cleaner: if avgqu-sz > 2.5 then back off. saves us next time. I'll sketch a PR.

sophia: @james please go ahead and pause. tag me when done and we'll re-route small batch of GPU requests to dedicated fallback pool. Note we should avoid a full region evacuation; just slow provisioning.

james: pausing janitor for eu-west2 now (rolling config change). going to set concurrency=0 and leave sampler disabled. will monitor provisioning queue.

ravi: thanks. provisioning backlog cleared after ~7m, GPU attaches resumed. leaving logs here for postmortem. we should consider adding a canary that runs cleaner in reduced mode right after pushes.

michael: opening PR for backoff guard and a metric for cleaner-induced iops. will tag for review.

sophia: postmortem notes — action items: 1) add runtime backoff threshold to janitor (michael), 2) add region-specific throttle toggles (ravi), 3) run a canary of the deep-scrub on 2 nodes before global rollout (ops).

james: done — janitor paused. monitoring shows node %util trending down. :thumbsup:

ravi: adding one more artifact — stacktrace from agent that failed GPU attach: 
```
2026-03-21T02:14:05Z ERROR attacher: attach failed: write timeout to nvme0n1, syscall=fsync, err=I/O error
```

sophia: good capture. we'll include that in the follow-up and schedule a short retro. thanks everyone.
